purpose: Take selected legacy ProgramBench replay candidates, reconstruct/hydrate replay context, run a fresh verifier through an injectable runner, and emit exactly one signed outcome row per candidate.
acceptance: selected candidate has tool, language_guess, failure_class, duplicate_cluster_id, legacy_row_hash, expected_verifier, and priority_score
candidate hash or cluster hash is validated before replay
successful replay without repair transition writes active_eval_evidence
each candidate writes exactly one signed row
each candidate writes a replay manifest
batch result reports zero loose artifacts
policy: Only fresh verifier-backed repair transitions train.
Replay-only evidence is not training fuel.
Infrastructure failures are signed outcomes, not loose artifacts.
does_not_prove: Does not prove a live ProgramBench workspace was successfully hydrated for Batch 001; the first run intentionally resolved missing workspaces into signed infra-failure rows.
